title: Disque
summary: Disque is an iOS music player that treats your library like a CD collection: albums sit on a shelf as 3D jewel cases, the now-playing disc actually spins, and every screen takes its colours from the cover art. It plays local files or streams from a Navidrome server, with offline downloads, synced lyrics and an audio effects panel. Built in SwiftUI, with a Next.js landing page, workflow assisted by Claude Code.

title: mashup
summary: mashup is a music discovery web app that finds the best matching tracks for a reference song. It integrates with Spotify and AcousticBrainz to analyze BPM, key, and other audio features, then suggests compatible tracks.

title: Deepcut
summary: Deepcut is a web API and interface that lets users discover random YouTube videos from curated playlists — perfect for finding new samples, inspiration, or tracks by chance.

title: twxntytwo - artist portfolio
summary: Artist portfolio — built from design to deployment, workflow assisted by Claude Code.

title: CHRISUPTOWN - artist portfolio
summary: Custom artist portfolio delivered for a client, from design to go-live. Content managed via Sanity CMS, full deployment pipeline. Workflow assisted by Claude Code.

title: Yolk
summary: Playful boiled‑egg timer microsite. Each recipe is a different cooking time with smooth micro‑interactions and accessibility built in.

title: Dark Spark
summary: A platformer game built for a Game Jam. Each time the hero is hit by an enemy, their torchlight weakens, reducing vision. To regain light (and health), the player must reach a fireplace. The hero starts with five torch charges.
